title: JSSC JILCCE Inter Level Recruitment 2026 Apply Online for 326 Post Re Open
postName: JSSC JILCCE Inter Level Combined Recruitment 2026
vacancyDetails: JSSC JILCCE Inter Level 2026 recruitment: Health Supervisor 137, Junior Regional Investigator 27, Multipurpose Health Worker 62, Field Assistant / Medical Assistant 27, Insect Collector 32, Fisheries Technical Assistant 41; total 326 posts.

shortDescription: JSSC JILCCE Inter Level Recruitment 2026 online application is open. Apply online from 05 August 2026 to 29 September 2026 for 326 vacancies.
content:
Jharkhand Staff Selection Commission (JSSC) has released the JILCCE Inter Level Recruitment 2026 notification for vacant posts across multiple departments in Jharkhand.

The online application window is open from 05/08/2026 to 29/09/2026 for a total of 326 vacancies. Candidates with 10+2 / Intermediate eligibility can apply for the posts listed in the official notification.

Important dates

  • Application begin: 05/08/2026
  • Last date to apply online: 29/09/2026
  • Fee payment last date: 30/09/2026
  • Correction date: 01-03 October 2026
  • Exam date: As per schedule
  • Admit card: Before exam

Department wise vacancies

  • Health Supervisor, Directorate of Health Services: 137
  • Junior Regional Investigator, Planning and Development Department: 27
  • Multipurpose Health Worker, Department of Health & Family Welfare: 62
  • Field Assistant / Medical Assistant, Urban Development and Housing Department: 27
  • Insect Collector, Directorate of Health Services: 32
  • Fisheries Technical Assistant, Agriculture & Cooperation – Fisheries Division: 41

Read the official JSSC brochure and apply before the deadline on the official portal.
